name: Repulsor Lifts (Champion)
description: Repulsor lifts are a form of rocket propulsion affixed to the lower part of a droid's chassis. Activating or deactivating the repulsors requires a bonus action and, while active, you have a flying speed of 50 feet. The repulsor lifts last for 1 minute. Once they've been used, they can't be used again until an hour has passed.
